title: Superficial Fungal Skin & Nail Infections
guideline: British Association of Dermatologists (BAD) / IDSA Guidelines for Tinea & Onychomycosis

clinical_targets.goal: Negative fungal microscopy (KOH mount) and culture from affected skin or nail scrapings
Complete resolution of erythema, peripheral active scaling border, and pruritus
Normal, clear proximal nail plate outgrowth without onycholysis or subungual hyperkeratosis

steps.title: Localized Tinea Corporis, Cruris, and Pedis
steps.rationale: Topical antifungals are first-line for localized dermatophyte infections. Allylamines (Terbinafine) are fungicidal and demonstrate faster clinical resolution and lower relapse rates than fungistatic imidazoles.

drug_classes.role: First-line fungicidal squalene epoxidase inhibitor with high cure rates in 1–2 weeks.
drug_classes.dosing: Terbinafine 1% cream applied once or twice daily for 1–2 weeks (extend 1 week past visible clearance).
drug_classes.pearls: Fungicidal mechanism yields sustained drug concentrations in stratum corneum for weeks after therapy completion, reducing recurrence.

drug_classes.role: Broad-spectrum fungistatic ergosterol synthesis inhibitors covering dermatophytes and Candida.
drug_classes.dosing: Clotrimazole 1% or Ketoconazole 2% cream applied twice daily for 2–4 weeks.
drug_classes.pearls: Ketoconazole 2% shampoo is first-line for Pityriasis (Tinea) versicolor and seborrheic dermatitis. Apply for 5 minutes before rinsing.

steps.title: Dermatophyte Onychomycosis (Tinea Unguium) & Extensive/Scalp Tinea
steps.rationale: Topical therapy has poor nail plate penetration. Oral systemic therapy is mandatory for dermatophyte onychomycosis, tinea capitis, and extensive tinea incognito.

drug_classes.role: Systemic eradication of Trichophyton rubrum / interdigitale embedded in nail bed and matrix.
drug_classes.dosing: Terbinafine 250 mg once daily (6 weeks for fingernails, 12 weeks for toenails); Itraconazole pulse 200 mg twice daily for 1 week/month (2 pulses fingernails, 3 pulses toenails).
drug_classes.pearls: Oral Terbinafine is gold standard with 75% mycological cure. Itraconazole has prominent CYP3A4 drug interactions (statins, calcium channel blockers). Full healthy nail regrowth takes 6–12 months.

special_populations.hepatic_impairment: Oral Terbinafine and Itraconazole are contraindicated in active or chronic hepatic disease due to risk of idiosyncratic hepatotoxicity.
special_populations.cardiovascular_disease: Oral Itraconazole carries a boxed warning against use in patients with heart failure or ventricular dysfunction (negative inotropic effect).
special_populations.pregnancy_lactation: Topical Clotrimazole and Terbinafine are preferred. Avoid oral systemic antifungals during pregnancy unless infection is life-threatening.

monitoring: Baseline and periodic (at 6 weeks) liver function tests (ALT/AST/bilirubin) for oral Terbinafine or Itraconazole courses.
